explanation: Coset Gaussians are determined by their coset: cosetGauss_apply gives mass rho(x)/M on the coset, and summing to 1 forces equal normalizers, so two equal cosets give equal laws; preimage is a map of the list of column laws. The stacked condition B x = P_j and (R B) x = R P_j is equivalent to B x = P_j.
